name: Norn Opportunity Brief
agentDescription: Norn converts verified capabilities into an explainable pipeline of funding, builder and commercial opportunities.

serviceDescription.capability: Rank up to 25 normalised opportunities against an evidence-backed profile and return fit, gaps, actions, provenance and an optional application draft.
requiredInputs: Capability profile with claim status and evidence
One or more normalised opportunities with source provenance
Maximum result count and pack preference

customer: Technical developers, teams and projects pursuing grants, hackathons, bounties, partnerships or paid integrations.
outcome: A schema-valid ranked opportunity brief with explainable scoring, evidence gaps, next actions, provenance digests and an optional approval-gated draft pack.

acceptanceCriteria: All input opportunities are evaluated or explicitly rejected
Scores remain within 0-100 and include criterion reasons
Claimed or aspirational evidence is never represented as verified
Request and result digests are returned
Generated pack remains draft and approval-gated

limits.ratePolicy: Hosting-level rate limit plus x402 per-call settlement; maximum 25 opportunities per invocation.

pricing.refundFailurePolicy: No business result is generated when payment verification fails. Settled-call failure handling follows the official SDK and recorded incident policy.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Every opportunity must include a source URL and timestamp. Fixture sources must be labelled and excluded from real submissions.

excludedActions: Fabricating experience, customers, revenue, deployment, partnership, audit or on-chain proof
Custody, signing or broadcasting for the user
regulatedConstraints: Respect source terms and authorised connector scopes
Human review required for every application submission
safety.sensitiveDataPolicy: Never retain or echo reusable authorisation, payment signatures, private keys or facilitator credentials.
